{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Writing in Basic: An Orthographic Chrestomathy''''' was a historical catalogue of all the different writing systems that were used to represent the language [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. It was compiled by the [[Galactic Languages Working Group]] of the [[Historical Council|New Republic Historical Council]].
